description: An aerial orthophoto depicting a coastal landscape in Sudersand, Sweden. The image shows a body of water in the foreground, likely the sea, with a sand beach extending along the coastline, estimated to be 20-30 metres wide. Inland from the beach, the landscape transitions into a mix of dense green forest, lighter green agricultural fields or clearings, and scattered human settlements or infrastructure, including roads and buildings. The image was provided by Lantmäteriet, Sweden.
